name: Bonchon Chicken
notes: 4 photos: 1.jpg (fold-out 'Bonchon Bites' panel) and 4.jpg (fold-out 'Korean Dishes' + 'Drinks & Desserts' panel) are the same current printed menu and are merged below. 2.jpg is a laminated dine-in menu covering the same items at noticeably lower prices (an older/superseded price list) and was excluded to avoid mixing conflicting prices for the same dishes. 3.jpg is storefront window signage (daily specials, a $40 'Pick 3' meal deal) with no per-item prices and only items already covered elsewhere, so it was skipped.
